intent_contract.text: Revise the prior adult original K-pop-idol-inspired navy one-piece beach campaign from a three-quarter rear pose to a three-quarter front pose while preserving the established model, swimwear, coastal setting, slender silhouette, low perspective, and warm sunlight.

Create a photorealistic mainstream swimwear campaign featuring a clearly adult original K-pop-idol-inspired woman in her mid-twenties with a distinct fictional face. The casting remains an original adult fashion model. She has luminous porcelain-pale skin, long glossy dark hair, and a slender athletic silhouette. She wears a sleek one-piece swimsuit in opaque matte fabric. The swimsuit is deep navy blue with wide straps, a clean neckline, and a full-coverage cut. At a bright ocean waterline, she stands barefoot in a three-quarter front view, her torso angled about 45 degrees toward the camera while her face turns softly toward the lens. Frame her full figure from a restrained low camera position in front and slightly to one side. Her legs remain gently adducted with the knees close while a small wedge of pale beach stays visible between the actual upper inner-thigh contours, preserving a readable thigh gap with believable anatomy. Warm late-afternoon sunlight traces her hair, shoulders, and legs; gentle surf, pale sand, and a clean horizon create polished contemporary K-pop editorial styling. Keep the mood confident and calm.

A clean background opening is bounded by the actual upper inner-thigh contours.

The opening is not merely wide stance, skirt opening, garment seam, shadow, or space below separated knees.
The close-leg geometry and narrow opening remain legible at thumbnail scale.
